title: In the Future
intro: What will the world be like in the future?

words.sentence: In the future, robots will clean our houses.
words.def: This machine looks like a metal person. It can walk and talk.

words.sentence: Computers will be very small in the future.
words.def: You use this machine with a keyboard and a mouse to write emails and play games.

words.sentence: Phones will be in our glasses one day.
words.def: You use this to talk to people who are far away.

parentTip.vi: Cùng con tưởng tượng: "What will we have in the future? Will cars fly?" và khuyến khích con dùng "will".
parentTip.say: Will cars fly in the future?

chat.ask: Would you like a robot at home?
chat.yes: Me too! It will tidy my room!
chat.no: Okay! You can tidy your room yourself!

gaps.s: One day, people will travel to Mars in a ___.
In the future, a ___ will clean my room. It will move like a person!
I will call you on my ___ tonight.

text.title: My Life in 2050
lines: In 2050, I will be a scientist.
I will live in a house with a robot. It will cook all my meals!
I will go to work in a flying car.
On holiday, I will travel to the moon in a spaceship.

questions.q: What job will the writer have?
Where will the writer go on holiday?
